details: Verified source: 33c13c9. The world consumes native character-input speed clamps, direction and gravity each frame. Collision support, the desktop yaw adapter and the character solver remain provisional.
Character input: 182 original PowerPC captures, including 24 ApplyVelocity calls. All 40 output words and subsequent impulse, decay and timer state match exactly for the tested cases.
Tetherball: Hit, angle wrapping, spin-down and the numeric Update prefix are now ported. Later model transforms feed back into ball radius and height and remain to be decoded.

Tetherball match decisions: 900 comparisons cover signed-byte counters, equal-win thresholds, timeout precedence, result fields and ordered UI/state requests. Complete round entry, animation and post-game execution remain unfinished.
Controller coverage remains 303 frames and 506 bindings across 14 tables. The original playground jump command is inert; Footie has a separate jump path.
All 471 embedded bank sounds decode. MPEG Layer 3 has 1,536 LSF, 72 spectral and 48 reorder comparisons; complete console PCM equality remains unverified.
Next: ball transform feedback, tuning selection/inheritance, round and gesture/animation callbacks, and Havok character-state movement. These are outside the passing native-port totals.
scope: Native reconstruction evidence is tracked separately from the whole-function decompilation and lifter percentages below.
